name: What kind of materials are used in luxury residential construction?
description: Luxury construction uses premium natural stones, hardwoods, high-performance windows, and smart home technology, prioritizing durability and aesthetic appeal.

mainEntity.name: What kind of materials are used in luxury residential construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury residential construction emphasizes high-quality, durable, and often sustainable materials. This includes premium natural stones like marble, granite, and quartz for countertops and flooring, exotic hardwoods for custom cabinetry and flooring, and high-performance windows and doors. Exterior finishes often feature natural stone cladding, stucco, or custom wood siding. Smart home technology integration, energy-efficient systems, and bespoke fixtures are also standard, all chosen for their aesthetic appeal and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury construction uses premium natural stones, hardwoods, high-performance windows, and smart home technology, prioritizing durability and aesthetic appeal.
